correctness.rationale: Nasu §2.1 establishes the complete-system contraction and the exceptional divisor. Adjunction yields K=(n-3)h and E²=1-n. The exceptional fibre E+R has n-1 transverse A1 nodes, and local first-jet equations give generic cycle multiplicity n-1. On S\E, degree-(n-1) ambient forms separate two-jets, permitting generic Morse tangencies. Conormal reflexivity in characteristic zero gives generic tangent-map degree one. The pencil Euler count, independently identical to c2(J1D), yields the stated polynomial. The provided exact checker passes for n=2..100; the written geometric proof handles the infinite range.

value.rationale: An infinite series of natural projective contractions acquires an explicitly quantified exceptional discriminant component. Subtracting its true cycle-theoretic multiplicity reveals the degree of the singular target’s projective dual, with an approximately elevenfold increase from the original embedding; the n=3 case sharpens geometry of a nodal K3 unprojection. This is a structural enumerative invariant not contained in the Hilbert obstruction theorem and not a routine isolated coefficient.
